name: StartupCincy Week 2026
tagline_text: TEN YEARS OF BOLD BETS (homepage h1); footer: "© 2026 STARTUPCINCY. A DECADE OF BOLD BETS."; cintrifuse.com promo: "Celebrate 10 Years of Bold Bets"
date_discrepancies: startupcincy.com/startupcincy-2026-sponsorship-opportunities/ still says "StartupCincy Week – October 6-9, 2026"; every other 2026 source (SCW homepage, agenda, startupcincy.com home, Cintrifuse) says October 5–8, 2026.
The Cintrifuse Annual Meeting ends at 10:00 per cintrifuse.com and 10:30 per the SCW registration add-on.
description: StartupCincy Week 2026 marks a decade of backing founders who refused to play it safe, building companies that didn't ask permission, and proving Cincinnati is where bold bets belong.
description_more: StartupCincy Week 2026 is four days of bold ideas, meaningful connections, and the people building what’s next. Explore the sessions, find the conversations that matter to you, and start mapping out your week.

Ten years of founders who refused to play it safe. One week where Cincinnati's startup community proves it all over again. Join 1,000+ founders, funders, and builders for four days of bold ideas, real deals, and unforgettable connections.

highlights.title: Student Pitch Competition (first-ever)
highlights.text: On Student Day, October 8, we're hosting our first-ever Student Pitch Competition, giving student founders the chance to take the stage, share what they're building, and put their ideas in front of Cincinnati's startup community.
highlights.bullets_lead: Win a spot in the Startup Fellows program as a Builder Fellow:
bullets: Receive a $10,000 non-dilutive grant to put toward your venture.
Get structured coaching and founder practice to keep building and growing.
Join a shared community of builders working alongside other founders.
highlights.builder_fellows: Builder Fellows is a paid, full-time, 10-week summer program in Cincinnati for student founders.
highlights.notes: Application form: undergraduates only; individuals or teams of up to four; applications close September 30, finalists notified by EOD October 2; pitch in person at Union Hall on the afternoon of October 8; prize is a "Golden Ticket" into Builder Fellows for Summer 2027. Agenda: "Five student teams. Eight minutes each. One Golden Ticket." (2:15 pm).

highlights.text: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 – 8:30 – 10am, Union Hall. Join us for a fireside chat with Braxton Brewing, mainstage panels, featured community leaders, curated networking experiences, & our signature happy hours, as part of StartupCincy Week, Oct 5-8, 2026.

highlights.title: Startup Clubhouse
highlights.text: The Startup Clubhouse was created as a more open environment for startup founders, employees and people looking for opportunities to mix and connect throughout the week.

highlights.title: Signature events
highlights.text: A handful of signature events anchor the week, including the kickoff, community lunch, and nightly happy hours. Beyond those staples, organizers open a public submission process and invite people throughout the ecosystem to propose sessions.

highlights.title: 2026 tracks
highlights.text: This year’s tracks include venture, small business, food founders and artists as entrepreneurs, along with a new city-building focus.

history.fact: Precursor: Techstars FounderCon 2016 brought "More than 1,000 of the nation's top business builders" to Cincinnati, Oct. 18–20, 2016 — "the first time in six years that Techstars is hosting their annual innovation event in a location outside of their traditional network of startup hubs". (Not a StartupCincy Week.)

First edition, "Techstars Startup Week Cincinnati, held Oct. 9-13 in Union Hall and other Downtown and Over-the-Rhine locations." Results reported by WCPO: 118 events (goal 60); attendance 4,500 (goal 3,000, counting people attending more than one event); $59,000 in sponsorship (goal $30,000); 1,441 unique names collected; 34% minority and 33% female participation; more than 4 million social impressions; guests from 50 cities, 17 states and five foreign countries. An attendee noted the week was free.

Origin story (2026 retelling): "What began as a grassroots movement and a Twitter hashtag" (#StartupCincy). Abby Grimm: "I think the first year of StartupCincy Week was maybe around 100 people, and this year we’re expecting 1500 people to come." (Conflicts with WCPO's 2017 attendance count of 4,500.)
StartupCincy Week 2021, October 26–29, 2021: virtual-only sessions, in-person happy hours, a virtual $75K FinTech Frontier Pitch Competition and an in-person Startup Job Fair.
history.note: From a search-engine summary of the sched.com page; the page itself was blocked (403/Cloudflare) and could not be read.

history.fact: Sixth annual StartupCincy Week, October 10–14, 2022: "Union Hall welcomed over 1,000 people ... 35 events featuring over 150 speakers across four venues." Key partners: Alloy Development Co., Blue North, CincyTech, Cintrifuse, ECDI, Endeavor, Flywheel Social Enterprise Hub, Product Refinery, REDI Cincinnati, and Reversed Out Creative.

StartupCincy Week 2023, October 23–26, theme "Homegrown Hustle": "we welcomed over 1,000 dreamers to Union Hall ... 45 events featuring over 100 unique speakers." Planning committees: Alloy, Aviatra Accelerators, Blue North, CincyTech, Cintrifuse, ECDI, Flywheel Social Enterprise Hub, gener8tor, Gratitude Collective, Miami University, and the University of Cincinnati. First formal partnership with the Over-The-Rhine Chamber of Commerce (Movers & Makers).

Eighth annual StartupCincy Week, October 7–10, 2024, in Over-the-Rhine, "presented by Cintrifuse" and "sponsored by Fidelity Private Shares, P&G, and many other ecosystem partners". Tickets: general admission ($50), corporate admission ($200), VC Investor ($300). Daily themes: Monday whole community, Tuesday high-growth tech founders and investors, Wednesday non-tech and early-stage founders, Thursday the region (Chamber Expo, small business and CPG workshops).

StartupCincy Week 2025, October 6–9, at Union Hall, Over-the-Rhine. New $200,000 live pitch competition, "Organized by the nonprofit Cintrifuse and powered by Connetic Ventures", with five finalists on Oct. 7 at Union Hall; judges Kirsten Moorefield (Cloverleaf), Somesh Saxena (Pantomath), Raf Garcia (Kernel). Organizers expected "more than 70 venture capital investors" and programming "shaped by more than 20 ecosystem partners".

2025 day themes (leftover hidden text on startupcincyweek.com): MONDAY, OCT. 6: Kick off the week with founder stories, ecosystem content, and get plugged into everything Cincinnati has to offer. (Kick-Off & Keynote, Best of Demo Night, Founder Development); TUESDAY, OCT. 7: A deep dive into venture capital for startups scaling here in the Midwest. (Cintrifuse Annual Meeting, State of Venture Panel, Startup Pitch Competition); WEDNESDAY, OCT. 8: Calling all early-stage and non-tech founders, this day is all about getting started with confidence. (Speed Mentoring, Upskilling Workshops, Hard Rock Happy Hour); THURSDAY, OCT 9: Explore how our patchwork of businesses and collective action are making Cincinnati a great place to build, grow, and scale. (Small Biz & Creative Workshops, Food Truck Fair, Regional Chamber Expo)

2025 Title Sponsors: P&G, Cintrifuse (with Cintrifuse Capital) and Fidelity Investments (the 2025 sponsors page; see orgs_2025.json). The Startup Clubhouse was hosted at Somerhaus. StartupCincy.com "was launched in 2025 as what Grimm called a “digital front door” for the region’s startup ecosystem" (Soapbox).
First-ever StartupCincy Awards, April 30, 2026, 5:30–7:30 pm at Union Hall: "This event kicks off StartupCincy’s 10th anniversary, honoring a decade of work and the people behind it."

10th StartupCincy Week, October 5–8, 2026, theme "Ten Years of Bold Bets": first-ever Student Pitch Competition and a full Student Day (Thursday); new city-building track; expected about 1,500 people.
